title: Apple : Talks to iHeartMedia About Collaborations -FT
text:
By Stephen Nakrosis
--Apple Inc. (AAPL) has been in talks with iHeartMedia to discuss possible collaborations, The Financial Times reported Thursday, citing people familiar with the discussions.
--Apple is one of several companies that have spoken to iHeartMedia about a deal, and is still in early stages of its discussion with the radio company, the report said.
--The report, citing one person briefed on the talks, said iHeartMedia is hoping Apple might acquire an equity stake.
Full story: https://www.ft.com/content/f9e8ccc2-dd84-11e8-9f04-38d397e6661c
--Write to Stephen Nakrosis at stephen.nakrosis@wsj.com
